originality.rationale: Actual full-text material in four highly relevant primary works examines shuffling rates, permutation design and iterate-time variances, but does not establish signed common-epoch multiplier equivalence to a complete multivariate convex-order reversal for all completed epochs. This is a specialized classification using a classical majorization lemma; unobserved equivalent specializations remain a precedence risk.
residual_risks: Majorization of weighted exchangeable sums is classical; the precise shuffle-once/RR signed-epoch specialization may appear in uninspected specialized probability or optimization literature.
Results of Domingo-Enrich concern all-iteration stationary variance; apparent opposite comparisons in small-step experiments are not contradiction but emphasize importance of endpoint scope.
Not extended to noncommuting Hessians or non-epoch-endpoint observations.
